annotations.title: Run screening or record a decision

description: Use this when the researcher wants AI screening run or a screening decision recorded. action run: dry_run defaults to true and reports how many records the AI would screen, how many go to human verification under the plan's quota and what blocks the launch; dry_run false launches (pass idempotency_key to make retries safe). action decide: only a decision the researcher states for a named record, never your own judgement; ask them to confirm the record and the reason first. Logged as sent from this chat. Bulk changes and the 'review' queue are done in the web app. Screening needs a confirmed email and an approved criteria stage.

dry_run.description: Default true: only report what would run and the quota used. false launches.

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the first launch instead of a second job.

reason.description: decide: why (required, as in the web app).

name: revisia_screening_act
